# Printalarm – Shagun Couture

> Custom design & print studio for personalized Shagun covers (wedding money envelopes) and luxury wedding stationery, shipping pan-India from Surat, Gujarat. Not affiliated with any Android app of a similar name. Full reference with pricing tiers, FAQs, and page links: https://printalarm.in/llms-full.txt

## What we sell
- Money Covers (Shagun/lifafa covers) — from ₹12/pc, premium 210 GSM art card, HD print, waterproof ink, optional gold foil + matte lamination
- Pocket Money Covers — compact personalized covers for smaller cash gifts
- Acrylic Money Frames — premium acrylic-frame money gifts, from ₹200
- Fully customizable: couple/family names, blessing text, photos, 100+ ready-made designs across Wedding and Sacred Tradition (Swaminarayan, Ganesha, Shrinathji, Hanumanji, Shiva) themes

## Delivery
- Standard delivery: 3-5 business days, pan-India
- Express delivery: 24-48 hour dispatch available
- Minimum order: 25 covers; bulk discounts at 100+ pcs (10 free covers)
